title: Validate stream completion and diagnose empty or interrupted upstream responses

authorization.source: User 2026-11-22: execute the proposed New API/Sub2API stream-completion solution and create a dedicated PR.
operations: create an isolated task worktree and branch
implement protocol completion, empty-response, and disconnect diagnostics in authorized paths
run Runtime/Desktop verification and record task evidence
commit and push the task branch
create one dedicated PR against master and leave it open
authorization.design_approval: User replied 执行 after the proposed completion-validation and disconnect-classification direction was explained.
not_authorized: merge the PR or change master
call real New API/Sub2API or other providers
delete or overwrite existing worktrees, branches, or unrelated files

include: require protocol-specific terminal evidence for Chat, Messages, and Responses streams
distinguish valid protocol completion from a completed stream with no observable generated content
classify missing terminal, explicit stream failure, upstream socket reset, client disconnect, and Gateway timeout separately
show suspected empty response, missing usage, and sanitized transport causes in request logs
preserve historical log compatibility and previously observed TTFT/token metrics
exclude: automatic retry or failover after streaming begins
request/response body or raw provider error persistence
schema migration, dependency changes, release/version changes, and real provider tests
merging the PR, publishing artifacts, or deleting task worktrees

acceptance: Chat [DONE] without a non-null finish_reason is not recorded as completed
Messages message_stop and completed Responses terminal events are accepted; explicit Responses failure/incomplete events are not
EOF before valid protocol completion is recorded as upstream_stream_incomplete
a complete stream with no observable content and missing/zero output-token evidence is surfaced as a suspected empty response
reasoning-only or thinking-only completions with no user-facing text, tool, or media output are surfaced as suspected empty responses even when output usage is nonzero
known media output remains observable, and success terminal frames are withheld until completion and non-empty output are validated
Chat passthrough evaluates finish_reason and [DONE] in frame order, including multiple frames delivered in one read
valid generated content with missing usage is distinguished without fabricating token values
ECONNRESET is mapped to a sanitized upstream_connection_reset; client cancellation is recorded as client_disconnected and does not count against upstream health
partial TTFT/usage survives failures; no retry occurs after output starts; request concurrency is released
legacy usage rows without optional completion metadata keep their existing Desktop display
full Runtime/Desktop suites, Desktop production build, and git diff --check pass
one dedicated PR exists against master, is open and unmerged
rollback: Revert only this task branch's commits. Keep the PR open until the user chooses otherwise, and preserve the task worktree, archived contract, primary worktree, sibling worktrees, and unrelated untracked directories.
owner_acceptance: Implementation and PR creation authorized; merge and real upstream acceptance remain pending.
